messages:
Maya: Quick thread  need a tight benchmark playbook for Wed webinar. Focus: latency vs token cost across three customer workloads. Deliverables: 1 one-pager, 3 visuals, 2 social variants, routing spec. Who owns?
Theo: Ill pull the telemetry and hand CSVs. Visuals proposal: (1) compact waterfall showing P50/P95/P99 by model, (2) Sankey showing tokens->cost with batching + cache lanes, (3) tiny decision grid: choose variant by SLO and $/k tokens.
Priya: Messaging guardrails: no "fastest" claims, always tie numbers to workload. Hero candidates: "Predictable inference economics for production teams" or "Control token spend without breaking latency SLOs." Use "up to" ranges.
Lin: Ill do the slide + social crops. Horizontal triptych so it exports as a slide and social card. Color: teal + slate + amber for tail callouts. Will annotate how saved tokens are computed.
Aria: Routing: segment CTAs by intent: SMB -> trial flow; Midmarket -> webinar + playbook; Enterprise -> demo + privacy brief. UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_playbook&utm_segment={seg}. Rule: if (intent_score>=70 AND api_key_created) -> AE queue; else nurture.
Maya: Two social tones needed: product (short) and business ROI (longer). Also a 20-word registration blurb.
Priya: Product: "One API, predictable token economics  see 3 workloads and tradeoffs. Wed 11am PT. Register:" ROI: "Benchmarks and a playbook to cut inference spend while protecting SLAs. Live demo." 20-word blurb: "Benchmarks and tactics to reduce inference spend while preserving latency SLOs  real workloads, routing, and actionables"
Theo: Will add methodology notes and sample queries with CSVs for the appendix. Using conservative language and per-workload callouts for legal.
Lin: Figma link incoming tomorrow AM. I'll include mobile/social crops and a tiny appendix callout on assumptions (cost_per_token, batching model).
Aria: I'll draft HubSpot mapping and UTM table so ops can wire routing.
Maya: Timeline: Theo data by EOD today, Lin mocks by tomorrow AM, Priya copy by tomorrow EOD, Aria routing doc by Friday. Ill assemble the one-pager Friday for review. Owners assigned. Thanks team :rocket:
